spec.name: M7.Domain.coefficients_indicator
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : M7.Domain.Support N), M6.Coordinates.coefficients N (M7.Supports.polynomial A) = M7.Supports.indicator A
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Function extensionality and accepted Supports.indicator_coefficient. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Domain.block_polynomial
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : M7.Domain.Support N), M6.Coordinates.blockPolynomial N (M7.Supports.indicator A) = M7.Supports.polynomial A
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Polynomial ext on coefficient n. Expand blockPolynomial sum over Fin N and coefficient. For n<N use unique Fin n; for N≤n all coefficients vanish by accepted degree_lt. Can use coefficient sum_eq_single and Supports.coefficient. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Domain.support_gcd
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : M7.Domain.Support N), Nat.gcd N (((M7.Supports.polynomial A).support ∪ (M7.Supports.polynomial B).support).gcd id) = M7.Domain.connectivityGcd A B
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Unfold connectivityGcd and rewrite twice by Supports.support. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Domain.admissible
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : M7.Domain.Support N), A.card = w → B.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ A → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ B → M7.Domain.connectivityGcd A B = 1 → M6.Final.Admissible N (M7.Supports.polynomial A) (M7.Supports.polynomial B)
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Unfold exact M6.Final.Admissible. Positivity from NeZero; anchor from Supports.anchor; card from Supports.support_card; span=max natDegree each less N from Supports.degree_lt; gcd from support_gcd. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Domain.shift_card
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : M7.Domain.Support N), ∀ r : ZMod N, (M7.Domain.shift A r).card = A.card
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Finite image cardinality: addition of a fixed residue is injective, including N=1. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.Domain.shift_anchor
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : M7.Domain.Support N), ∀ q : ZMod N, q ∈ A → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ M7.Domain.shift A (-q)
queries: Polynomial finite sum coefficient X power
spec.guidance: Use image witness q and q+(-q)=0. Preserve exact target and concrete definitions; no oracle premises. Return tactic lines without leading by.
